notes: Welcome page: two clear buttons – Start new setup, and Already have HouseRunner – Connect this device. The second opens a pop-up with the 8-character code and a QR code to scan with a phone that’s already connected; it closes by itself and opens HouseRunner as soon as the phone connects it.

Starting a new setup leaves any earlier setups in your Google account untouched – the page now says so. The “start again” and “move account” options have gone from the welcome page: connect this device first, then do those from Setup.
